hints.title: Ordering Chronological Visits
hints.text: Sort each user visits chronologically to find consecutive visit intervals.

hints.title: Lead Window Offset with Boundary Fallback
hints.text: use the lead window function partitioned by user_id and ordered by visit_date, providing '2021-01-01' as the default value when there is no subsequent visit.

hints.title: Taking Maximum Window per User
hints.text: compute the difference between the next visit date and current visit date with datediff, then take max grouped by user_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Ranked AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           visit_date,
           LEAD(visit_date, 1, '2021-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_date) AS next_visit
    FROM UserVisits
)
SELECT user_id,
       MAX(DATEDIFF(next_visit, visit_date)) AS biggest_window
FROM Ranked
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY user_id;
```

complexity.notes: LEAD window function partitions and sorts visits per user, taking maximum date difference.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries to find the next visit require scanning the user's visit history repeatedly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window partitioning and sorting takes O(N log N) time and computes adjacent date deltas in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should leverage LEAD with default fallback parameter to compute the boundary window cleanly.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def biggest_window(user_visits: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    user_visits = user_visits.sort_values(by=['user_id', 'visit_date'])
    user_visits['visit_date'] = pd.to_datetime(user_visits['visit_date'])
    user_visits['next_visit'] = user_visits.groupby('user_id')['visit_date'].shift(-1).fillna(pd.to_datetime('2021-01-01'))
    user_visits['diff'] = (user_visits['next_visit'] - user_visits['visit_date']).dt.days
    res = user_visits.groupby('user_id')['diff'].max().reset_index()
    res.rename(columns={'diff': 'biggest_window'}, inplace=True)
    return res.sort_values(by='user_id')
